description: This file defines the IntentDialogFragment class, which extends DialogFragment. It displays a dialog showing an activity name and a list of intent flags, with options to move the associated task to the front, kill the task, or copy flags. It handles user interactions for managing activity tasks and displaying intent-related information in an Android app.

classes.name: IntentDialogFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment subclass that displays a list of intent flags for a given activity, with options to manage the task associated with the activity.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of IntentDialogFragment with specified activity name, flags, and task ID.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, extracting arguments from the bundle.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, sets up views, and defines click behaviors for dialog actions.

methods.name: removeTask
methods.description: Removes the task with the specified task ID from recent tasks.

methods.name: moveTaskToFront
methods.description: Brings the specified task to the foreground.
